Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) malware designed to infect Fortigate network security appliances
Persistent implant recovering after every reboot by injecting a backup of itself in the process responsible for rebooting the system
Hides by intercepting system calls to avoid detection
Discoverer: Military Intelligence and Security Service (MIVD) of the Netherlands
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2022-42475 FortiOS SSL-VPN vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of Coathanger malware implant on FortiGate devices, including fully patched devices if compromised before patching
